3774.title: Skill listing retains duplicate content across roots
3774.rootCauseOneLine: The server concatenates shared and provider registrations; provider deduplication only compares file paths.
3774.proposedFix: Separate catalog deduplication from ID resolution and design content identity with daemon compatibility.
3774.caveats: Host discovery was simulated; no live provider context overhead was measured. No fix PR because protocol and precedence decisions exceed simple-fix limits.
